author: antigram
body:
• Your minecraft username (most recent name if changed) antigram
  • The reason you were temp-banned/banned ddos threats. (LOL) Your staff tells me to calm it? I get kicked 1 for doing it and i didnt do anything and got "accidently kicked" another 2 times. And Ive had enough The staff tell me to watch the language and in other games i see people "KYS" "faggot" "Your shit" and I guess im being targeted... And I told them "RIP YOUR ROUTER" as a joke because im pissed. I got kicked 3 times today for bullshit and Im fed up with your staff always kicking me on "accident"
  • Why you should be unbanned from the server. I love to play the server THE DTM one in general new maps more fun. 

There are some things to think about before making an appeal.
  • Was my temp-ban or ban really false? Nope It was a perm ban.
  • Do I have any evidence to show the staff if was false? Nah fam
  • Have I waited long enough to be un-banned? 1 day
  • Have I been caught ban evading? Yeah/no Im at a friends and we are having a lan party.. the accounts toxicsniper212, Rileysay, Faze_potat0, have been false banned, because I got banned on (Antigram) And they ip banned us, like the fuck.... You gotta atleast tell them to get in ts. Because your mods which are dumb just ip banned them for no reason and had no proof I was alting. Dumb af..  Atleast no what your doing and stop doing ip checks, because that doesnt proof anything.

title: Antigram's Ban appeal

replies.author: Posighdun
replies.body:
Hello Antigram,

Our Staff are human beings, we make mistakes every now and then like every human beings. However no matter how angry you are about this mistake you should not threaten one of our staff. This appeal is denied. 
 
Regards,

Posighdun - Avicus Network Senior Moderator
